referenceFunction.generalComment: Data are based on information from a recent dismantling study of various consumer electronics; UUID: 026ac74b-d080-3f4e-b291-770eaf24350d
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset for LED screen monitors are taken from the other dismantling studies for consumer electronic devices (source: Babbitt et al., 2020; Peeters et al., 2012). The average size of the modeled LED monitor is 23 inches, with a total weight of approximately 3.2 kg. The monitor comprises metals (copper, steel), plastics (ABS), PCB, and flat panel glass, whose weight shares are defined from the bill of materials data from Babbitt et al., 2020. The environmental footprint results are comparable with those of Bhakar et al., 2015.
